description: VT 18% (expanding, t-1) + DD 7/22 brake overlay on CR08+D01 crowding defense base

gate0_pit.c2_same_day_circular: PASS - vt_lagged = c(1.0, head(vt_scalar, -1)) provides 1-day lag; dd_lag = c(0, dd_pct[-n_f]) provides 1-day lag
gate0_pit.c3_same_period_agg: PASS - no within-period aggregate applied to same period
gate0_pit.c4_financial_lag: N/A - overlay only, no financial statement data
gate0_pit.c5_overlay_t_minus_1: PASS - both VT and DD use t-1 signals
gate0_pit.c6_survivorship: PASS - inherits parent sim with LIQ_THRESHOLD=2e8 filter
gate0_pit.c7_auto_detect: PASS - lookahead_detector clean on all scripts
gate0_pit.c9_vt_dd_same_day: PASS - VT uses vt_lagged (1-day lag), DD uses dd_lag (1-day lag)
gate0_pit.c11_data_time_axis: PASS - no external data sources, uses only strategy returns
gate0_pit.c13_negate_factors: PASS - factor_engine uses Z_Score_Aligned via align_factor_direction()
gate0_pit.c15_factor_db_load: PASS - factor_engine uses arrow::open_dataset() bulk load

gate1_performance.assessment: FAIL - SR 0.616 far below 1.0 threshold. CAGR 7.33% far below 16% target. IR negative = KOSPI outperforms risk-adjusted. MDD 26.76% exceeds 25% target. VT+DD overlay reduced MDD from 31.77% (base) to 26.76% but at CAGR cost (7.98% -> 7.33%). Overlay achieves minimal benefit.

gate2_artifacts.assessment: All stage artifacts present (S0-S4). Charts generated.

gate3_role_honesty.assessment: S4 claims core_alpha but S3 shows factor_mean_max_corr=0.943 (near-redundant factors). SR 0.616 and negative IR disqualify core_alpha. Judge overrides to DIVERSIFIER (weak). Role mismatch is honest on the hurdle side (declared diversifier).

gate4_statistical.assessment: FAIL - OOS retention 29.4% (IS SR 0.763 -> OOS 0.224) = severe overfitting/alpha decay. Alpha trend ratio 0.485 (recent 3Y SR 0.299 vs full 0.616) = alpha halved in recent period. 10 consecutive negative alpha months is concerning. Strong stress outperformance (3/3) is the only positive signal.

gate5_ff5.assessment: FF5 not run. Cannot verify factor-adjusted alpha. Given base SR 0.616, FF5 alpha is almost certainly insignificant.

s3_orthogonality_review.assessment: POOR - Factor correlation 0.943 = CR08 and D01 are near-identical signals. Novelty 0.324 = low. Return corr 0.829 = high overlap with existing strategies. The 2-factor blend is effectively a 1-factor strategy.

mutation_comparison.assessment: VT18+DD7/22 trades 0.65pp CAGR for 5pp MDD reduction. SR actually decreased. Calmar unchanged (0.274 vs 0.251). Not a meaningful improvement.

rejection_reasons: Factor redundancy: CR08-D01 corr=0.943 renders 2-factor blend a single-factor strategy
Base signal too weak: SR 0.633 pre-overlay, no overlay can fix underlying alpha deficit
Severe alpha decay: recent 3Y SR 0.299 vs full 0.616 (ratio 0.49)
OOS degradation: 29.4% retention = likely overfitted or time-varying alpha exhausted
Negative IR: benchmark outperforms on risk-adjusted basis
overall_verdict.summary: STR_1422_s5 (VT18+DD7/22) is PIT-clean but fundamentally unsalvageable. The CR08+D01 crowding-defense factor pairing has 0.943 cross-correlation, making the 2-factor blend effectively single-factor. The base signal (SR 0.633) is too weak for any overlay to rescue to Grade A territory. Alpha has decayed to SR 0.299 in the most recent 3 years. OOS retention of 29.4% confirms the limited alpha is not robust. The VT+DD overlay marginally improves MDD but does not address the core problem: insufficient and decaying alpha from a redundant factor pair.
